rejected_rule.statement: A party cannot use section 70(2) of the Partition Law as a shield, but only as a weapon.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: To put differently, the petitioners could, if no steps were taken for two years, make an application under section 70(2) seeking dismissal of the action. But, once a party takes a step to prosecute the case, the petitioners cannot object to it on the basis that no steps were taken for two years, as, a step has already been taken within two years before such objection is taken.
